headline: Fisherman's Row And Stlican Shelf Erupt In Fierce Base Swaps
war_summary: Fisherman's Row has erupted into an intense multi-point struggle, recording fourteen strategic base transitions over the past two hours across Eidolo, Arcadia, and Black Well. Stlican Shelf has similarly reawakened from its earlier pause, logging five fresh base actions in two hours and leaving one strongpoint contested in no-man's-land amid mounting casualty rates. Along Farranac Coast and Linn of Mercy, fluid clashes continued with three base exchanges apiece during the two-hour window, centering around The Bone Haft and Lathair as casualty rates sharply accelerated. In contrast, strategic base turnover paused over the past two hours in Weathered Expanse, Stonecradle, and Mooring County, though severe frontline pressure persists unabated; Weathered Expanse alone absorbed nineteen hundred casualties in that span. Callahan's Passage likewise remains locked in heavy attrition, registering over twenty-three hundred casualties across the two-hour period without immediate territorial alteration.
